shots.scene: 欣欣站在铁架台旁，铁圈上架着一只分液漏斗，里面有两层液体，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a ring stand holding a separatory funnel with two liquid layers, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲反应后处理。
overlay: 反应后处理：萃取、洗涤与干燥

shots.scene: 分液漏斗、洗瓶、干燥剂粉末三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a separatory funnel with two layers, a wash bottle, and a flask with white drying powder. No people.
shots.narration: 萃取、洗涤、干燥，一步一步来。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着装满液体、塞紧的分液漏斗用力摇，满脸紧张
shots.prompt_en: The young male student shakes a tightly stoppered, very full separatory funnel hard, looking nervous.
shots.narration: 阿杰第一次萃取，摇得太猛。

shots.scene: 塞子被顶开、液体喷出的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a stopper popping off a funnel with liquid spraying out, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 漏斗里憋着气，塞子差点冲开。

shots.scene: 小研戴护目镜，示范倒置漏斗、尖嘴朝向通风柜内侧放气
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing goggles and gloves, holds an inverted funnel inside a fume hood with the tip pointing toward the back of the hood.
shots.narration: 小研说：先学会放气。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 后处理的每一步，都有讲究。

shots.section_title: 反应得到的是粗混合物
shots.scene: 反应瓶里混着各种形状的小分子图标
shots.prompt_en: A reaction flask filled with many different small molecule icons mixed together. No people.
shots.narration: 反应很少只得到想要的那一种产物。
overlay: 反应得到的是粗混合物

shots.section_title: 反应得到的是粗混合物
shots.scene: 目标分子被高亮，周围是副产物、原料和试剂
shots.prompt_en: One target molecule icon glows among by-product, leftover starting material and reagent icons. No people.
shots.narration: 副产物、原料、试剂，全混在一起。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着分液漏斗
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a separatory funnel on a ring stand.
shots.narration: 液液萃取是最常用的分离方法。

shots.scene: 一串步骤卡片连成一条线
shots.prompt_en: A row of linked blank step cards with arrows between them. No people.
shots.narration: 设计好萃取和洗涤的顺序，就叫后处理。

shots.section_title: 两种不相溶溶剂分两层
shots.scene: 分液漏斗中上下两层液体，界面清晰
shots.prompt_en: A separatory funnel with a clear upper layer and a clear lower layer separated by a sharp line. No people.
shots.narration: 两种互不相溶的溶剂，分成两层。
overlay: 两种不相溶溶剂分两层

shots.section_title: 两种不相溶溶剂分两层
shots.scene: 分子在两层之间上下移动的箭头
shots.prompt_en: Molecule icons moving between the two layers with up and down arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 各组分按溶解度，分到不同的层。

shots.scene: 上层贴有机图标，下层贴水滴图标
shots.prompt_en: The top layer marked with an organic flask icon and the bottom layer marked with a water drop icon. No people.
shots.narration: 一层几乎总是水，另一层是有机溶剂。

shots.scene: 中性分子在有机层，带电离子和盐在水层
shots.prompt_en: Neutral molecule icons sit in the organic layer; charged ion and salt icons sit in the water layer. No people.
shots.narration: 中性分子爱有机相，离子和盐爱水相。

shots.scene: 萃取：目标分子被拉进新溶剂；洗涤：杂质被冲走
shots.prompt_en: Two panels: the target molecule pulled into a new solvent, and impurity icons washed away. No people.
shots.narration: 萃取拉出产物，洗涤洗走杂质。

shots.scene: 萃取液瓶打勾，洗涤液瓶进废液图标
shots.prompt_en: An extract flask with a green check, and a wash liquid flask heading to a waste container icon. No people.
shots.narration: 萃取液要留，洗涤液弃去。

shots.scene: 铁架台上的铁圈，垫一圈软木圈，分液漏斗稳稳坐在上面
shots.prompt_en: A ring stand with an iron ring padded by a cork ring; a separatory funnel sits securely in it. No people.
shots.narration: 铁圈加软木圈，稳稳托住漏斗。

shots.scene: 手指关紧活塞
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand turns the stopcock to the closed position. No people.
shots.narration: 加液前，先关好活塞。

shots.scene: 漏斗下方放一个干净烧瓶，接住漏下的液滴
shots.prompt_en: A clean flask is placed under the funnel and catches a drip from the tip. No people.
shots.narration: 下面放个干净烧瓶，漏了也能接住。

shots.scene: 漏斗装到四分之三处打勾，装满到顶打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two funnels: one filled to three quarters with a green check, one filled to the top with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 装液不超过四分之三。

shots.scene: 太满的漏斗里液体无处翻动
shots.prompt_en: In an overfilled funnel the liquid has no room to move when tilted. No people.
shots.narration: 太满了，根本混不开。

shots.scene: 两层液体翻滚混合，接触面变大
shots.prompt_en: The two layers tumble and mix, creating many small droplets with a larger contact area. No people.
shots.narration: 充分混合，接触面大，分配就快。

shots.scene: 漏斗里压力表指针上升
shots.prompt_en: A pressure gauge icon over the funnel with the needle rising. No people.
shots.narration: 可是一混合，里面压力就升高。

shots.scene: 挥发的溶剂蒸气和冒出的气泡两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: rising solvent vapor and gas bubbles forming in a liquid. No people.
shots.narration: 易挥发溶剂和产气的试剂，尤其明显。

shots.section_title: 倒置握塞，尖嘴背人放气
shots.scene: 小研先轻轻旋摇、颠倒漏斗
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing goggles and gloves, gently swirls and turns the funnel over before shaking.
shots.narration: 猛摇之前，先轻轻旋摇、颠倒。
overlay: 倒置握塞，尖嘴背人放气

shots.section_title: 倒置握塞，尖嘴背人放气
shots.scene: 倒置漏斗，手掌压紧塞子，液体流离活塞
shots.prompt_en: The funnel is held upside down with a palm pressing the stopper; the liquid drains away from the stopcock. No people.
shots.narration: 倒过来，压紧塞子，让液体离开活塞。

shots.section_title: 倒置握塞，尖嘴背人放气
shots.scene: 尖嘴朝向通风柜内侧，缓缓打开活塞，气体排出
shots.prompt_en: The funnel tip points toward the back of a fume hood as the stopcock opens slowly and gas escapes. No people.
shots.narration: 尖嘴背着自己和别人，慢慢开活塞。

shots.scene: 小研握紧漏斗用力振摇几下
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds the funnel firmly and shakes it briskly for a few seconds.
shots.narration: 握紧振摇几秒，再倒置放气。

shots.scene: 耳朵图标旁的气流声波逐渐消失
shots.prompt_en: An ear icon next to sound waves of escaping gas that grow smaller and disappear. No people.
shots.narration: 反复几次，直到听不到出气声。

shots.scene: 漏斗放回铁圈，两层慢慢分开
shots.prompt_en: The funnel is set back in the ring and the two layers slowly separate. No people.
shots.narration: 放回铁圈，静置分层。

shots.scene: 两层之间出现一层浑浊的乳化层
shots.prompt_en: A cloudy milky band forms between the two layers in the funnel. No people.
shots.narration: 两层中间糊了一层，这叫乳化。

shots.scene: 放大镜下乳化层里的细小颗粒
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass shows tiny particles inside the cloudy band. No people.
shots.narration: 多由细小颗粒引起，很难消除。

shots.scene: 双手轻轻旋摇、颠倒漏斗
shots.prompt_en: Hands gently swirl and turn the funnel over instead of shaking it. No people.
shots.narration: 轻轻旋摇颠倒，很少乳化。

shots.scene: 时钟图标旁一个绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon next to a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 多花点时间混合，值得。

shots.scene: 沙漏图标旁静置的漏斗
shots.prompt_en: A funnel standing still next to an hourglass icon, the cloudy band slowly thinning. No people.
shots.narration: 已经乳化？办法一，静置等待。

shots.scene: 玻璃棒轻轻搅动乳化层
shots.prompt_en: A glass rod gently stirs the cloudy band inside the funnel. No people.
shots.narration: 办法二，轻轻旋摇，用玻璃棒搅动。

shots.scene: 向漏斗里加入少量饱和食盐水
shots.prompt_en: A small amount of saturated salt solution is poured into the funnel. No people.
shots.narration: 办法三，加几毫升饱和食盐水。

shots.scene: 水层里盐离子增多，有机液滴被挤回上层
shots.prompt_en: Salt ion icons fill the water layer and push organic droplets back up into the organic layer. No people.
shots.narration: 盐让有机溶剂更难溶在水里。

shots.scene: 布氏漏斗里铺一层白色助滤剂，接抽滤瓶
shots.prompt_en: A filter funnel with a white filter aid layer, on a filter flask connected to a vacuum hose. No people.
shots.narration: 最后一招：整体通过硅藻土抽滤。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着漏斗的上层和下层，头顶问号
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the top and bottom layers of a funnel, with a question mark above.
shots.narration: 随时问自己：哪层在上，哪层在下？

shots.scene: 两层上各贴一张空白标签卡
shots.prompt_en: Two blank tag cards attached to the top and bottom layers. No people.
shots.narration: 每一层里溶着什么，都要心里有数。

shots.scene: 密度轻的在上、重的在下的天平图标
shots.prompt_en: A diagram with a light block floating on top and a heavy block sinking below. No people.
shots.narration: 密度小的在上，大的在下。

shots.scene: 水层约1克每毫升，两种情况的分层图
shots.prompt_en: Two funnel diagrams: an organic layer above water, and an organic layer below water. No people.
shots.narration: 稀水溶液和水差不多重。

shots.scene: 瓶子图标分别放在上层和下层
shots.prompt_en: Solvent bottle icons placed by the top layer and by the bottom layer. No people.
shots.narration: 己烷、乙醚在上，二氯甲烷在下。

shots.scene: 浓溶液让密度箭头改变方向
shots.prompt_en: A heavy solute icon making the density arrow flip direction. No people.
shots.narration: 溶质很浓时，密度可能变化很大。

shots.scene: 滴管取几滴加入盛水的试管
shots.prompt_en: A dropper adds a few drops from one layer into a test tube with a little water. No people.
shots.narration: 分不清？取几滴滴进水里试试。

shots.scene: 清澈溶解打勾为水层；浑浊或分层为有机层
shots.prompt_en: Two test tubes: one clear with a water drop icon, one cloudy with a separate layer and an organic icon. No people.
shots.narration: 溶了不浑是水层，浑了分层是有机层。

shots.scene: 两个贴标签的烧杯都被保留，垃圾桶被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two labeled beakers kept on the bench, with a trash bin icon crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 没确认产物都拿到，哪层都不丢。

shots.section_title: 放好贴签烧杯，取下塞子
shots.scene: 小研在漏斗下放一个贴空白标签的烧杯，并取下塞子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student places a beaker with a blank label under the funnel and removes the top stopper.
shots.narration: 下面放好贴标签的烧杯，取下塞子。
overlay: 放好贴签烧杯，取下塞子

shots.section_title: 放好贴签烧杯，取下塞子
shots.scene: 塞着塞子液体流不出的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a stoppered funnel with liquid stuck in the stem. No people.
shots.narration: 塞子不取，液体放不下来。

shots.scene: 打开活塞，下层流入烧杯
shots.prompt_en: The stopcock is opened and the bottom layer flows into the beaker. No people.
shots.narration: 打开活塞，放出下层。

shots.scene: 界面接近活塞时放慢，正好在交界处关闭
shots.prompt_en: As the boundary nears the stopcock the flow slows and stops exactly at the boundary. No people.
shots.narration: 快到界面就放慢，恰好在交界处关。

shots.scene: 上层留在漏斗中，又倒入新的洗液
shots.prompt_en: The top layer stays in the funnel and a new wash solution is poured in. No people.
shots.narration: 上层还要洗，就留在漏斗里继续。

shots.scene: 上层从上口倒入另一个贴标签烧杯
shots.prompt_en: The top layer is poured out through the top opening into a second labeled beaker. No people.
shots.narration: 洗完了，就倒进另一个贴签烧杯。

shots.scene: 下层向下箭头、上层向上箭头
shots.prompt_en: A funnel with a downward arrow from the stopcock for the bottom layer and an upward arrow from the top for the top layer. No people.
shots.narration: 下层从活塞放，上层从上口倒。

shots.scene: 从活塞放上层的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of the top layer being drained through the stopcock, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 这样不会把杂质带回产物里。

shots.section_title: 示例：乙酸苯酯的后处理
shots.scene: 一个酯分子图标被高亮
shots.prompt_en: An ester molecule icon highlighted with a glow. No people.
shots.narration: 举个例子：后处理乙酸苯酯。
overlay: 示例：乙酸苯酯的后处理

shots.section_title: 示例：乙酸苯酯的后处理
shots.scene: 产物在乙醚层，乙醚和水分成两层
shots.prompt_en: The product icon sits in an ether layer floating above a water layer. No people.
shots.narration: 产物溶于乙醚，乙醚又不溶于水。

shots.section_title: 示例：乙酸苯酯的后处理
shots.scene: 上层乙醚，下面依次换上不同水溶液
shots.prompt_en: The ether layer stays on top while different aqueous wash solutions are swapped in below. No people.
shots.narration: 就用乙醚作有机层，用水溶液来洗。

shots.scene: 小研在空白计划板上列出杂质和对应洗液
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes a plan on a blank board, matching impurity icons to wash bottle icons.
shots.narration: 根据杂质的性质，选择洗液。

shots.scene: 洗液量和重复次数图示
shots.prompt_en: A measuring icon showing a small portion of wash liquid, and a repeat arrow icon. No people.
shots.narration: 每次用量少一些，每种洗两三次。

shots.section_title: 碳酸氢钠洗去酸，勤放气
shots.scene: 酸分子进入水层变成离子
shots.prompt_en: An acid molecule icon moves from the organic layer into the water layer and becomes a charged ion. No people.
shots.narration: 乙酸，用饱和碳酸氢钠洗掉。
overlay: 碳酸氢钠洗去酸，勤放气

shots.section_title: 碳酸氢钠洗去酸，勤放气
shots.scene: 漏斗里冒出很多气泡，压力表上升
shots.prompt_en: Many bubbles rise in the funnel and a pressure gauge icon climbs. No people.
shots.narration: 会放出二氧化碳，一定要勤放气。

shots.section_title: 碳酸氢钠洗去酸，勤放气
shots.scene: 放掉水层，重复图标
shots.prompt_en: The water layer is drained and a repeat arrow shows two more rounds. No people.
shots.narration: 放掉水层，再洗两次。

shots.scene: 胺分子加上质子后进入水层
shots.prompt_en: Amine molecule icons pick up a proton and move into the water layer. No people.
shots.narration: 三乙胺等弱碱，用稀盐酸洗。

shots.scene: 混合、放气、放水层，重复三次
shots.prompt_en: Icons of mixing, venting and draining with a repeat arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 同样混合放气，重复三次。

shots.scene: 乙醚层里漂着小水滴
shots.prompt_en: Small water droplet icons floating inside the ether layer. No people.
shots.narration: 乙醚里还溶着一点水。

shots.scene: 加入食盐水，水滴被拉进水层
shots.prompt_en: Brine is added and the water droplets are pulled down into the water layer. No people.
shots.narration: 用饱和食盐水洗一次，带走部分水。

shots.scene: 一勺极细的白色粉末
shots.prompt_en: A spatula holding very fine white powder. No people.
shots.narration: 硫酸镁干燥又快又好。

shots.scene: 粉末表面吸附着产物分子；旁边一个弱酸图标
shots.prompt_en: Product molecule icons stuck to the fine powder surface, next to a mild acid icon. No people.
shots.narration: 但粉太细会吸附产物，还略偏酸。

shots.scene: 向标有机层的烧杯少量加粉末并旋摇
shots.prompt_en: Small amounts of powder are added to a beaker of organic solution and swirled. No people.
shots.narration: 少量多次加入，边加边摇。

shots.scene: 粉末在液体中像雪花一样飘动
shots.prompt_en: Loose powder swirls freely in the liquid like a snow globe. No people.
shots.narration: 摇起来像雪花球，放置后仍有散粉。

shots.scene: 颗粒状的白色干燥剂
shots.prompt_en: Granular white drying agent in a flask of organic solution. No people.
shots.narration: 硫酸钠慢一些，但基本中性。

shots.scene: 沙漏图标旁的烧瓶
shots.prompt_en: The flask with granules next to an hourglass icon. No people.
shots.narration: 颗粒吸附少，干燥五到十分钟。

shots.scene: 折叠滤纸放在漏斗里，溶液滤入圆底烧瓶
shots.prompt_en: A fluted filter paper in a funnel; the solution filters into a round-bottom flask. No people.
shots.narration: 用折叠滤纸过滤掉干燥剂。

shots.scene: 洗瓶冲洗滤纸上的干燥剂三次
shots.prompt_en: A wash bottle rinses the drying agent on the filter paper three times. No people.
shots.narration: 再用干溶剂冲洗三次，别留下产物。

shots.scene: 圆底烧瓶旁出现旋转蒸发仪图标
shots.prompt_en: A round-bottom flask next to a rotary evaporator icon. No people.
shots.narration: 接下来去旋转蒸发仪浓缩。

shots.scene: 欣欣手捧空白讲义
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a thick blank lab manual.
shots.narration: 演示只是预习，讲义一定要读。

shots.section_title: 乙醚：极易燃、会生成过氧化物
shots.scene: 乙醚瓶上的易燃象形图，蒸气沿台面流向远处火源
shots.prompt_en: An ether bottle with a flammable pictogram; heavy vapor flows along the bench toward a distant flame icon. No people.
shots.narration: 乙醚极易燃，蒸气会贴着台面流走。
overlay: 乙醚：极易燃、会生成过氧化物

shots.section_title: 乙醚：极易燃、会生成过氧化物
shots.scene: 试剂瓶上的开封日期标签和日历图标
shots.prompt_en: A solvent bottle with a blank date label and a calendar icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 久放会生成过氧化物，注意开封日期。

shots.section_title: 乙醚：极易燃、会生成过氧化物
shots.scene: 小研在通风柜里操作，周围没有火源和热板
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works with the funnel inside a fume hood with no flames or hot plates nearby.
shots.narration: 在通风柜里用，附近不许有火源。

shots.section_title: 卤代溶剂与含卤废液分开收集
shots.scene: 二氯甲烷瓶上的健康危害象形图
shots.prompt_en: A solvent bottle with a health hazard pictogram on its blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 二氯甲烷、氯仿有毒，别吸入蒸气。
overlay: 卤代溶剂与含卤废液分开收集

shots.section_title: 卤代溶剂与含卤废液分开收集
shots.scene: 两个废液桶，图标不同，分别接收
shots.prompt_en: Two waste containers with different pictograms side by side, each receiving its own type of liquid. No people.
shots.narration: 含卤和不含卤的有机废液，分开收集。

shots.section_title: 卤代溶剂与含卤废液分开收集
shots.scene: 洗涤后的水层倒进废液桶，水槽被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Used aqueous wash layers go into a labeled waste container; a sink drain icon is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 洗下来的水层，也按本校规定收集。

shots.scene: 分液漏斗装水，检查活塞和塞子处
shots.prompt_en: A separatory funnel filled with water while a magnifying glass checks the stopcock and stopper for leaks. No people.
shots.narration: 用前先装水，试试活塞和塞子漏不漏。

shots.scene: 活塞处滴水的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of water dripping from a stopcock, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 漏液就换一个，别带病上岗。

shots.section_title: 溶剂会透过一次性手套
shots.scene: 溶剂分子穿过一次性手套的示意图
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of solvent molecules passing through a thin disposable glove. No people.
shots.narration: 乙醚、二氯甲烷会透过一次性手套。
overlay: 溶剂会透过一次性手套

shots.section_title: 溶剂会透过一次性手套
shots.scene: 小研摘下沾了溶剂的手套，换上新手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student removes a splashed glove and puts on a fresh pair.
shots.narration: 沾上了马上换，并洗手。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现软木圈、接收瓶、四分之三刻度图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a cork ring, a catch flask and a three-quarter fill mark.
shots.narration: 架稳、关活塞、放接收瓶、别装满。

shots.scene: 倒置放气和乳化层图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an inverted funnel venting away from people and a cloudy emulsion band. No people.
shots.narration: 尖嘴背人勤放气，乳化先预防。

shots.scene: 密度箭头和两个贴签烧杯图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a density arrow and two labeled beakers. No people.
shots.narration: 分清上下层，没确认前都不丢。

shots.scene: 碳酸氢钠、稀酸、食盐水、干燥剂图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a bicarbonate bottle, a dilute acid bottle, a brine bottle and a drying agent jar. No people.
shots.narration: 按杂质洗涤，再干燥过滤。

shots.scene: 火焰打叉、两个废液桶、手套图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a crossed-out flame near ether, two waste containers and a fresh glove. No people.
shots.narration: 远离火源，废液分类，手套勤换。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一只装着澄清溶液的圆底烧瓶，挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a round-bottom flask of clear solution and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 产物到手，下一步浓缩，下次见！
